Thanks for sharing. Your readings help work out where "ripe" really is.

**1. Attach your file.** Drag the CSV you downloaded from your machine's page into this box (or click the paperclip). It's called something like `ripeomatic-readings.csv`.

<!-- drag your CSV file here -->

**2. Anything worth knowing?** (optional) For example: the variety if it isn't Hass, whether the kitchen was warm or cold, or if a reading looked wrong.



---
The file holds numbers only: a random machine id, times, and the measurements. No name, location or network details. It will be added to the public data in this repo, and you can ask for it to be removed at any time.
